notes: Country-level VIZA RAG seed for vietnam. This file is the source of truth for this country's visitor/tourism visa knowledge and is designed to evolve alongside the country-specific form-filling workflow.

chunks.title: 中国护照越南短期旅游签证建议
chunks.content: 中国护照持有人计划去越南短期旅游时，VIZA AI 应优先考虑越南官方 E-visa 电子签证路线，而不是美国 DS-160、英国 Standard Visitor 或申根签证。越南移民局官方页面说明，电子签证由 Vietnam Immigration Department 通过电子系统签发；境外外国人可通过 evisa.gov.vn 官方入口自行申请。回答时先确认目的地是越南、国籍、旅行目的、停留天数、入境口岸和是否需要多次入境。

chunks.title: Vietnam e-visa validity and basic conditions
chunks.content: Vietnam E-visa is valid for a maximum of 90 days and can be single or multiple entry. The official Immigration Department page lists basic conditions: the applicant is outside Vietnam, holds a valid passport, and is not in a category suspended from entry under Vietnamese law. The fee is paid through the official electronic payment gateway and is not refunded if the application is refused. Travellers should check the official list of ports that allow entry and exit with an E-visa.

chunks.title: Vietnam official e-visa portal domains
chunks.content: The legacy Vietnam Immigration Department portal states that, from 08:00 on 11 November 2024 GMT+7, the Vietnam Electronic Visa Portal operates on the new domains thithucdientu.gov.vn and evisa.gov.vn. For VIZA AI: direct users to official .gov.vn portals and warn them to avoid unofficial paid lookalike sites when possible.

chunks.title: Vietnam fields to collect before filling the form
chunks.content: identity, passport, nationality, portrait/photo, travel dates, entry and exit ports, address in Vietnam, purpose, email/contact and single/multiple entry selection

chunks.title: Vietnam supporting documents and review checklist
chunks.content: passport biodata page, portrait/photo, entry/exit plan, accommodation/address and payment method Workflow guardrails: VIZA should separate eligibility check, form filling, document upload, payment and post-approval travel/entry checks. Do not guarantee entry; border authorities make the final decision.

chunks.title: Standard passport identity-field answer rules
chunks.content: Standard-answer identity fields must be answered from the applicant's passport biodata page, official identity document, MRZ where that field is encoded, or the official form's dropdown options. This applies to passport number, name, date of birth, sex, nationality, issuing country, issue date, expiry date, issuing authority, place of issue, and passport/document type. Treat issuing country, place of issue, and issuing authority as distinct fields and never substitute one for another. Place of issue / 签发地点 asks for the location recorded on the passport or required by the official form, such as a city, province, municipality, or a country selected from an official country-only dropdown; copy the passport's Place of issue value when present, and enter a country only when the form explicitly asks for Country of issue / Issuing country or provides a country-only selector. Issuing authority / 签发机关 asks for the organization printed under Authority / Issuing authority. For Chinese ordinary passports, National Immigration Administration, PRC / 中华人民共和国国家移民管理局 and MPS Exit & Entry Administration / 公安部出入境管理局 are issuing-authority examples only and must never be suggested as place-of-issue answers. Do not infer either field from the pickup city, residence city, application country, or travel destination. If the passport prints a different value for the requested field, use that exact field value. For passport type, select Ordinary / Regular / Normal only for ordinary personal passports; select Diplomatic, Official, Service, Special, Travel document, Refugee, or Other only when the document explicitly indicates that type. Official sources reviewed for this standard field rule include China National Immigration Administration certificate-issuing-authority notices and the Passport Law of the People's Republic of China; the passport biodata page and the destination's official field wording remain the final sources for the applicant's individual answer.

chunks.content:
Official-source field answer norms for vietnam.
Use these norms only as filling guidance; if a live official form, passport, or uploaded document shows a more specific value, that document controls the answer.

Crawled source URLs: https://evisa.xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn/trang-chu-ttdt ; https://thithucdientu.gov.vn ; https://evisa.gov.vn

Issue, expiry, and validity fields:
- Vietnam E-visa is valid for maximum of 90 days, single or multiple entry.

Travel plan and port fields:
- Vietnam E-visa is valid for maximum of 90 days, single or multiple entry.
- List of Ports that allowed foreigners enter and exit Vietnam by E-visa.
- Not falling into the cases of suspension from entry prescribed in Article 21 of Law on foreigners' entry into, exit from, transit through, residence in Vietnam.

Accommodation, host, and address fields:
- They should send visa applications via the inviting or guaranteeing agencies and organizations to the competent agency of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Answering rule: for closed-list fields, prefer the exact official option label/value. For document-backed fields, copy the passport, official identity document, application account, itinerary, invitation, accommodation, insurance, funds, or uploaded support document rather than guessing from a city, country, or prior answer.

chunks.title: Vietnam pre-arrival declaration scope
chunks.content: Vietnam's official Pre-Arrival Information portal is https://prearrival.immigration.gov.vn/. It is a separate traveller declaration workflow and is not a visa or an e-visa. VIZA must first determine whether the traveller's current nationality, purpose, route and entry date fall within the portal's required scope; do not infer a requirement from the existence of a visa application. If the portal requests visa credentials, copy them from the approved official visa and never invent a visa number.

chunks.title: Vietnam pre-arrival data and official options
chunks.content: When the official portal applies, the declaration uses passport and traveller identity details together with the trip, entry point, accommodation and contact information shown by the current official form. Preserve the portal's official option values for passport type, visa information, travel mode, port, flight and accommodation; Chinese labels are display-only. Stop and ask the user when a required official option or visa credential is unknown.

chunks.title: Vietnam declaration is independent of the visa route
chunks.content: A submitted pre-arrival declaration does not grant entry permission and does not replace a Vietnam E-visa, visa exemption or other immigration permission. Keep the VN_PREARRIVAL_DECLARATION package separate from VN_E_VISA and show two independent actions when both are required. Confirm current timing and applicability on the official portal before submission.

chunks.title: Vietnam pre-arrival form channel and scope
chunks.content: Use only the official Vietnam Immigration Pre-Arrival Information portal at https://prearrival.immigration.gov.vn/. This product is for the standalone arrival declaration and must not reuse the VN_E_VISA schema. The official portal controls whether the declaration is needed and which fields are visible; VIZA should route work, study, residence and other regulated purposes to a separate workflow.

chunks.title: Vietnam pre-arrival fields to collect
chunks.content: Collect only the fields currently required by the official portal: passport and identity data, contact and residence information, entry and travel details, Vietnam address/accommodation and any visa or permit information the portal asks for. Keep official dropdown values unchanged for submission. Detailed application answers belong on the dedicated form page, not in chat.

chunks.title: Vietnam pre-arrival review and handoff
chunks.content: Before submission, compare every identity value with the passport, every visa value with the approved official document when one is required, and every trip value with the itinerary. Do not report success until the official portal returns its confirmation or reference. If a required field or applicability condition cannot be verified, leave the declaration unresolved and direct the traveller to the official portal.

chunks.title: Standard passport identity fields for Vietnam pre-arrival
chunks.content: Copy passport number, name, date of birth, sex, nationality, issue date, expiry date, issuing authority, place of issue and passport type from the applicant's passport or official identity document. Never infer these values from residence, destination or a prior e-visa application.
